title: Whitebox Website
about: White Box is a boutique brand agency representing an exclusive portfolio of international manufacturers — including Bossini, Tom Dixon, Bover, Vetaparket, Luce di Carrara, and Talenti — to architects, designers, and developers across the Middle East. I designed the marketing website, built to showcase each manufacturer's collections and notable projects (fixtures in landmarks like Atlantis The Palm and Burj al-Arab) to a high-end trade audience.
